auditor_emma: Hi team — auditor here. Need a minimal evidence bundle and control mapping for the emergency KMS key change tied to incident INC-2026-0410. One canonical file per evidence type, with sha256 and a 1-line provenance note. Map each to SOC 2 CC6.1 and ISO A.10.1. Can you confirm you can deliver by EOD?

rachel_sec: Yes. We'll produce: KMS audit export, rotation-runner log, GitHub change + approval export, IAM snapshot for affected principals, vuln-triage export, and post-rotation verification logs.

tom_infra: Links we'll put in the manifest (presigned):
- kms-export: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-audit/2026-04/kms-export-inc0410.json?X-EX=presigned
- rotation-run: https://logs.redwood.example.com/rot/rot-2026-0410-03.log
- pr: https://github.com/redwood/ops-config/pull/958 (approved by @nate_oncall)

nate_oncall: Confirmed approval at 2026-04-10T09:12:02Z via GitHub UI + 2FA. I'll add an emailed signed note and attach to manifest v1.

auditor_emma: Please include the exact queries/time windows used to generate logs. Also need proof that the old key could not decrypt post-rotation (smoke test).

```
index=gcp_kms resource.keyRing=prod action=cryptoKeyVersion.create OR action=cryptoKeyVersion.setPrimary OR action=cryptoKeyVersion.destroy | table _time, user, action, request_id
```

auditor_emma: Control mapping (one sentence each) please.

rachel_sec: Control mapping (short):
- kms-export.json -> SOC 2 CC6.1: evidences key lifecycle events and operator identity; ISO A.10.1: demonstrates key management operations.
- rotation-run.log -> SOC 2 CC6.1: shows authorized execution and operator context; ISO A.10.1: supports operational execution records.
- pr-958-approvals.csv -> SOC 2 CC6.1: proof of documented approval and approver identity; ISO A.10.1: demonstrates change control.
- iam-snapshot.json -> SOC 2 CC6.1: snapshot of access assignments to validate least-privilege; ISO A.10.1: documents role assignment and restrictions.
- rbac-note-0410.pdf -> SOC 2 CC6.1: business justification for access changes; ISO A.10.1: formal rationale for control changes.
- smoke-log.txt -> SOC 2 CC6.1: verification that new key functions and old key is non-functional; ISO A.10.1: post-change validation evidence.
